reasoning_content: All tools installed. Now run `mise exec -- npm ci`. Note .npmrc has ignore-scripts=true which may cause issues with some packages like playwright. But the guide says to run it. Let's do it.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && timeout 550 mise exec -- npm ci 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
